title: CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan Price List: Plan Fees and Plan Year Terms
content:
The CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan is sold at six tiers. The plan fee, the way it is billed, the length of the plan year, renewal and the cancellation terms for each tier are as follows.

## Schedule

| Tier | Annual plan fee (USD) | Plan fee billing | Plan year (months) | Renews automatically | Renewal fee increase cap (percent) | Cancellation notice (calendar days) | Refund of unused prepaid plan fee (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CalCare Pay-Per-Service | 0.00 | none (no plan fee is billed) | 12 | yes | 0 | 30 | 0 |
| CalCare Basic Plan | 495.00 | annually in advance | 12 | yes | 5 | 30 | 0 |
| CalCare Standard Plan | 1250.00 | annually in advance | 12 | yes | 5 | 30 | 0 |
| CalCare Accredited Plan | 2950.00 | annually in advance | 12 | yes | 4 | 60 | 50 |
| CalCare Onsite Plan | 7500.00 | quarterly in advance | 12 | yes | 4 | 60 | 50 |
| CalCare Enterprise Plan | 18000.00 | quarterly in advance | 12 | yes | 3 | 90 | 50 |

## Column definitions

- **Annual plan fee**: annual plan fee, USD; 0.00 means no plan fee.
- **Plan fee billing**: when the plan fee is billed.
- **Plan year**: length of one plan year in months.
- **Renews automatically**: whether the plan renews automatically for another plan year.
- **Renewal fee increase cap**: largest increase, percent, of the plan fee at renewal.
- **Cancellation notice**: calendar days of written notice to cancel the plan.
- **Refund of unused prepaid plan fee**: percent of the unused share of a prepaid plan fee refunded by credit memo on cancellation.

## Reading the schedule

- CalCare Pay-Per-Service carries a plan fee of 0.00, so nothing is billed as a plan fee on that tier; its fee billing entry is "none" and its renewal cap of 0 percent has no fee to act on.
- The four tiers from CalCare Basic Plan to CalCare Accredited Plan bill the plan fee annually in advance; CalCare Onsite Plan and CalCare Enterprise Plan bill it quarterly in advance.
- Every tier runs a plan year of 12 months and renews automatically.
- The refund of the unused share of a prepaid plan fee is 0 percent on CalCare Pay-Per-Service, CalCare Basic Plan and CalCare Standard Plan, and 50 percent on CalCare Accredited Plan, CalCare Onsite Plan and CalCare Enterprise Plan.
- Notice runs 30 calendar days on the first three tiers, 60 on CalCare Accredited Plan and CalCare Onsite Plan, and 90 on CalCare Enterprise Plan.

## Illustration (hypothetical figures)

On the CalCare Basic Plan the plan fee is 495.00 and the renewal cap is 5 percent, so a renewed CalCare Basic Plan fee may rise by at most 5 percent of the fee it renews from. A renewal fee is not fixed by this schedule; the cap is the ceiling on the increase only.
